title: Oracle Fusion SCM Functional Consultant
jobDescription: Work Mode: WFO Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion SCM Functional Consultant with expertise in implementing and supporting Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Management modules. The role involves leading end-to-end implementations, conducting solution workshops, configuring SCM modules, supporting integrations, and collaborating with business stakeholders to deliver scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong functional expertise in Procurement, Inventory, Order Management, and Costing, along with experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and reporting tools. Key Responsibilities: Implementation & Support Lead end-to-end implementation and support of Oracle Fusion SCM solutions. Manage Oracle Fusion SCM implementation lifecycle, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-Go-Live support. Conduct solution workshops, architecture discussions, and business process mapping sessions. Lead SCM functional teams and ensure alignment with business objectives. Functional Expertise Configure and support Oracle Fusion SCM modules, including: Self-Service Procurement Purchasing Sourcing Supplier Management Supplier Qualification Management Procurement Contracts Inventory Management Order Management Costing Manufacturing Perform root cause analysis, issue resolution, and coordinate Oracle Service Requests (SRs). Support business process optimization across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycles. Integration & Reporting Collaborate with technical teams to develop integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Develop and maintain OTBI, BI Publisher, and operational reports. Support data migration activities using FBDI and other Oracle migration utilities. Testing & Production Support Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and quarterly Oracle Cloud updates. Monitor daily batch jobs, interfaces, and scheduled processes. Provide production support, including month-end and period-end closure activities. Stakeholder Management Conduct user training sessions and knowledge transfer activities. Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery. Mentor junior consultants and provide functional guidance to project teams. Experience 6–12 years of experience in Oracle ERP, with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion SCM. Hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation and support projects Required Skill Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion SCM modules: Self-Service Procurement Purchasing Sourcing Supplier Management Supplier Qualification Management Procurement Contracts Inventory Order Management Costing Manufacturing Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes. Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Expertise in OTBI, BI Publisher, and Oracle reporting solutions. Experience with FBDI and Oracle data migration processes. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing experience. title: EBS Technical Consultant
jobDescription: Work Mode: WFO Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS Technical Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite (R12), PL/SQL, Oracle Forms & Reports, and Oracle Workflow. The role involves developing technical solutions, customizations, interfaces, reports, and integrations while supporting Oracle EBS implementations, enhancements, and production support. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical skills across Oracle development tools and a good understanding of Oracle Applications architecture and core business modules. Key Responsibilities: Develop, customize, and maintain Oracle EBS applications using PL/SQL, SQL, Oracle Forms, and Oracle Reports. Design and develop reports using BI Publisher (XML Publisher). Develop and maintain Oracle Workflow solutions using Oracle Workflow Builder. Design, develop, and support Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Integrations using standard Oracle APIs. Develop and maintain Concurrent Programs, Shell Scripts, and SQL Loader programs for data processing and migration. Perform technical analysis, coding, unit testing, deployment, and production support. Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize database objects, SQL queries, and PL/SQL programs. Collaborate with functional consultants to understand business requirements and deliver technical solutions. Prepare technical documentation, including Technical Design Documents (TDD), deployment documents, and support documentation. Support SIT, UAT, Go-Live, and post-production activities. Required Skills: 5–10 years of experience in Oracle E-Business Suite (Oracle EBS) Technical Development. Hands-on experience in Oracle EBS R12 is preferred. Strong hands-on experience in: Oracle E-Business Suite (R12 preferred) PL/SQL and SQL Oracle Forms & Reports BI Publisher (XML Publisher) Oracle Workflow Builder Oracle Interfaces and Standard/Public APIs Concurrent Programs Shell Scripting (Unix/Linux) SQL Loader and Data Migration tools Good understanding of: Oracle Applications Architecture Multi-Org Architecture Oracle EBS Core Modules such as Finance, SCM, or HRMS Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning skills. Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving abilities. title: Temenos Transact AA (Islamic Banking) Consultant
jobDescription: Work Mode: WFO Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Temenos Transact AA (Arrangement Architecture) Consultant with strong expertise in Islamic Banking product configuration. The consultant will be responsible for configuring Islamic lending and deposit products within Temenos Transact (T24), conducting client workshops, gathering business requirements, preparing functional documentation, and supporting end-to-end implementation activities including configuration, testing, and user acceptance. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in AA product setup, parameter configuration, and translating business requirements into scalable Temenos solutions Key Responsibilities: Configure and maintain Islamic Banking products in Temenos Transact Arrangement Architecture (AA) across multiple companies. Design, configure, and validate Islamic Lending and Deposit products based on business requirements. Perform hands-on AA parameter setup, product configuration, and maintenance within Temenos Transact. Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to gather requirements and provide functional guidance on Islamic Banking products and Core Banking capabilities. Translate business requirements into Temenos functional solutions and update the Customer Configuration Environment (CCE). Perform sanity checks on Islamic Banking Solution (ISB) configurations and ensure compliance with business requirements. Prepare functional documentation, including Customer Solution Design (CSD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and User Guides for L3 gaps. Support Unit Testing, QA, SIT, and UAT activities, ensuring successful implementation and issue resolution. Resolve functional queries related to AA product configuration and provide post-implementation support. Collaborate with business, technical, and implementation teams to ensure successful project delivery. Required Skills: 8–12 years of experience in Temenos Transact (T24) with strong expertise in Arrangement Architecture (AA). Hands-on experience configuring Islamic Banking products, including Lending and Deposit products. Strong knowledge of AA parameter setup, product configuration, and maintenance. Good understanding of Temenos Core Banking functionality and Islamic Banking principles. Experience conducting client workshops, requirement gathering, and business process mapping. Expertise in preparing CSD, FSD, and functional documentation. Experience supporting Unit Testing, QA, SIT, and UAT. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent communication and client-facing consulting experience. Good to Have: Experience in multi-company Temenos Transact implementations. Exposure to Islamic Banking transformation or migration projects. Knowledge of Customer Configuration Environment (CCE). Experience working in Agile delivery environments. Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing capabilities.
